items.source_locator: Nurse Licensure Compact, Nurses & the NLC: an active multistate license permits practice in other NLC jurisdictions without separate licenses; practice is subject to the remote-state laws/rules where the patient is located.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: Nurse Licensure Compact telehealth guidance: nursing practice occurs where the patient is located; the nurse must hold authority there through a license, multistate privilege, or applicable exception.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI Acute Coronary Syndromes Guideline: in ECG-confirmed STEMI, reperfusion management is time-sensitive and should not be delayed solely for biomarker confirmation.
items.finding: Stem corrected to state that ST elevation meets current STEMI diagnostic criteria, removing threshold ambiguity; key D retained.

items.source_locator: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline, biomarker section: BNP/NT-proBNP supports diagnosis/exclusion and risk assessment in dyspnea but is interpreted with clinical context and other causes of elevation.
items.finding: Source upgraded from patient education to the primary guideline.

items.source_locator: American Lung Association COPD pursed-lip breathing guidance: slower/prolonged exhalation creates back-pressure, helps keep airways open longer, and helps release trapped air.
items.source_version: Current ALA COPD patient guidance reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Authoritative patient-education source retained because no more exact open primary guideline locator for this bedside mechanism was identified.

items.source_locator: CDC First Aid for Seizures: turn a person lying down onto the side to keep the airway clear; do not restrain, put objects in the mouth, or give food/water until fully alert.
items.finding: Source upgraded from non-governmental first-aid page to CDC.

items.source_locator: World Society of Emergency Surgery Bologna Guidelines for adhesive small-bowel obstruction: prior abdominal surgery is a major cause; SBO presents with abdominal pain, vomiting, distention, and constipation/obstipation and requires prompt evaluation.
items.source_version: WSES Bologna evidence-based guideline, DOI 10.1186/s13017-018-0185-2; currentness reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Stem corrected from postoperative day 4 to two weeks after abdominal surgery and answer narrowed to postoperative small-bowel obstruction, removing ileus-vs-obstruction ambiguity.

items.source_locator: DailyMed Lactulose Solution, Clinical Pharmacology: colonic acidification converts ammonia to ammonium, traps it, reduces absorption, and laxative action promotes fecal nitrogen elimination in portal-systemic encephalopathy.
items.finding: Source locator/currentness strengthened; content retained.

items.source_locator: ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS 2024 Hyperglycemic Crises Consensus Report: HHS requires marked hyperglycemia/hyperosmolality without severe ketonemia or metabolic acidosis; DKA requires ketonemia plus acidosis.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: Consortium for Spinal Cord Medicine clinical practice guideline, Acute Cardiovascular Management after Spinal Cord Injury, recommendations 18-20: exclude other causes of hypotension, recognize/treat neurogenic shock, and manage symptomatic bradycardia after high SCI.
items.source_version: PVA/Consortium CPG; currentness cross-checked against newer 2025 acute SCI guidance on neurogenic shock/hypotension; reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Generic ACS education URL replaced by a direct clinical practice guideline; content retained.

items.source_locator: American College of Gastroenterology Guidelines: Management of Acute Pancreatitis, 2024, 119(3):419-437; diagnostic evaluation uses pancreatic enzymes and lipase is preferred over amylase when nonpancreatic amylase elevation is a concern.
items.finding: Generic ACG guidelines homepage replaced by exact current guideline.

items.source_locator: ASPEN Position Paper, The Use of Visceral Proteins as Nutrition Markers: albumin/prealbumin characterize inflammation rather than nutrition status and should not diagnose protein-energy malnutrition.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: AASLD/EASL Hepatic Encephalopathy Guideline, recommendations 4, 6 and 9: HE is a clinical/exclusion diagnosis; increased blood ammonia alone adds no diagnostic, staging, or prognostic value.
items.source_version: AASLD/EASL guideline DOI 10.1002/hep.27210; current guideline listing rechecked 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded from educational commentary to the primary guideline.

items.source_locator: American Thyroid Association Thyroid Function Tests: elevated TSH with low free T4/free T4 index is the characteristic biochemical pattern of primary hypothyroidism; T3 is not the preferred confirmatory test.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: American College of Rheumatology 2020 Gout Guideline: use a treat-to-target urate-lowering strategy with serial serum urate and a target below 6 mg/dL.
items.source_version: Current ACR gout guideline page reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: Fourth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction: troponin above the 99th percentile indicates myocardial injury; MI requires acute ischemic evidence integrated with biomarker pattern and clinical/ECG/imaging context.
items.source_version: Fourth Universal Definition remains current on 2026-08-15; fifth definition is scheduled for later 2026; reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded to exact consensus definition and currentness explicitly checked.

items.source_locator: 2025 International Pressure Injury Guideline, R1/R4/R5: reposition at-risk individuals despite support surfaces and individualize intervals by mobility, tissue tolerance, clinical condition, comfort, sleep, goals, and support surface.
items.source_version: International Guideline Fourth Edition chapter published 2025-02-25; reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded to exact current repositioning chapter.

items.source_locator: ESPEN Practical Guideline: Clinical Nutrition and Hydration in Geriatrics, recommendations 65 and 68: use directly measured serum/plasma osmolality to evaluate low-intake dehydration; simple bedside signs such as skin turgor and mouth dryness should not diagnose it in older adults.
items.finding: Item rewritten because the prior version conflated volume depletion with low-intake dehydration and over-relied on nonspecific bedside signs.

items.source_locator: MedlinePlus Using a cane: hold the cane on the side opposite the weaker/injured leg and move the cane forward with the affected leg during level walking.
items.finding: Generic NCBI Bookshelf URL replaced by exact NIH patient instruction.

items.source_locator: ASPEN Safe Practices for Enteral Nutrition Therapy: assess feeding tolerance using multiple symptoms/exam findings; gastric residual volume should not be a stand-alone tolerance determinant.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: CDC Adult Activity Guidelines: at least 150 minutes/week moderate-intensity aerobic activity or equivalent plus muscle-strengthening activity on at least 2 days/week.
items.finding: No material content correction required.

items.source_locator: American Academy of Pediatrics Child Passenger Safety policy: infants/toddlers remain rear-facing as long as possible until reaching the seat manufacturer's rear-facing height or weight limit.
items.finding: Currentness explicitly rechecked; content retained.

items.source_locator: NIAAA Screen and Assess Use: AUDIT-C is a validated brief alcohol screen; a positive/higher-risk result prompts further clinical assessment and appropriate brief intervention/referral, not a stand-alone AUD diagnosis.
items.source_version: NIAAA Core Resource last revised 2025-04-30; reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded to exact current NIAAA screening workflow.

items.source_locator: Open RN Nursing: Mental Health and Community Concepts, 2nd ed. 2025, Severe Anxiety to Panic and Table 9.7f: remain with the client, emphasize safety, calm low-pitched voice, short/simple communication, personal space, and reduced cognitive load.
items.source_version: Open RN 2nd edition published 2025-11-01; NCBI Bookshelf current page reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Generic NCBI homepage replaced by exact current chapter; secondary nursing reference retained because no more exact primary bedside guideline was identified.

items.source_locator: American Association for Emergency Psychiatry Project BETA De-escalation Consensus: respect personal space, one person speaks, use concise calm communication, identify wants/feelings, set respectful limits, and offer realistic choices; restraint is last resort.
items.source_version: Project BETA consensus, DOI 10.5811/westjem.2011.9.6864; currentness reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Generic Joint Commission workplace-violence page replaced by the exact de-escalation consensus supporting every option-A element.
